title: Astera Labs Deepens AI Infrastructure Role With Israel R&D And Hyperscaler Deals
title_zh: Astera Labs 通过以色列研发和超大规模交易深化人工智能基础设施作用
summary: Astera Labs opened a new R&D and design center in Israel, focused on addressing memory and data bottlenecks in AI workloads. The company announced new partnerships with Microsoft, Intel, SAP, and Amazon to advance AI connectivity and CXL attached memory solutions.
summary_zh: Astera Labs 在以色列开设了一个新的研发和设计中心，专注于解决人工智能工作负载中的内存和数据瓶颈。该公司宣布与微软、英特尔、SAP 和亚马逊建立新的合作伙伴关系，以推进人工智能连接和 CXL 附加内存解决方案。

title: Carlyle’s flagship buyout funds gain after flurry of portfolio IPOs
title_zh: 凯雷旗舰收购基金在一系列投资组合首次公开募股后获利
summary: US private equity pioneer Carlyle Group says performance in its flagship buyout business has stabilised after taking a handful of investments...
summary_zh: 美国私募股权先驱凯雷集团表示，在进行了少量投资后，其旗舰收购业务的业绩已趋于稳定......

title: KKR & Co. CFO Sees Better 2026 Deal Outlook, Says Diversified Earnings Aren’t Priced In
title_zh: KKR & Co. 首席财务官认为 2026 年交易前景更好，表示多元化收益并未反映在定价中
summary: KKR & Co. Inc. (NYSE:KKR) CFO Rob Lewin said the firm is entering 2026 with improving visibility into deal activity, stronger fundraising momentum, and a more diversified earnings base that he believes is not fully reflected in the company’s share price.
summary_zh: KKR & Co. Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：KKR）首席财务官 Rob Lewin 表示，进入 2026 年，该公司交易活动的可见性不断提高，融资势头更加强劲，盈利基础更加多元化，他认为这些并没有完全反映在公司股价中。

title: KKR to Add Sports Franchise Exposure Through Arctos Acquisition
title_zh: KKR 将通过收购 Arctos 增加体育特许经营业务
summary: KKR & Co. is set to acquire Arctos Partners in a $1.4B stock-and-cash deal, boosting its sports investing platform and launching a new Solutions business.
summary_zh: KKR & Co. 计划以 1.4 亿美元的股票和现金交易收购 Arctos Partners，从而增强其体育投资平台并推出新的解决方案业务。

title: M&A Deals Thriving in 2025: ETFs in Focus
title_zh: 2025 年并购交易蓬勃发展：ETF 成为焦点
summary: M&A deals are booming in 2025 despite fewer transactions -- megadeals, AI bets and Fed cuts may fuel ETFs like MNA, IAI, KBWB & CHAT.
summary_zh: 尽管交易量减少，但 2025 年并购交易仍将蓬勃发展——大型交易、人工智能押注和美联储降息可能会推动 MNA、IAI、KBWB 和 CHAT 等 ETF 的发展。
